nav.enterMoveHint: Three times a week, 15 minutes, at home.

landing.title: Kalmio Move
landing.tagline: Three times a week, 15 minutes, at home.
landing.lead: Short, guided movement in your own living room. No membership, no equipment, no rush.

what.title: What is it?
what.body: Kalmio Move plans a few short sessions a week for you: walking, strength, stretching or chair exercises, whatever suits you. Every session is a series of steps, one instruction and one demonstration at a time.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.body: We start with ten short questions and the week adapts to them. The rule is on every screen: stop if you feel dizzy, feel chest pain, or find it unusually hard to breathe.

points.home: At home, at your own pace
points.plain: Plain words, one instruction at a time

landing.signInHint: After signing in, set-up takes about a minute.

start.title: Let's start
start.subtitle: Seven short steps and you have a first session today.
start.subtitle_formal: Seven short steps and you will have a first session today.

steps.modalities: What do you enjoy, or what would you try?
steps.modalities_formal: What do you enjoy, or what would you try?
steps.equipment: What do you have at home?

forWhom.other: I am setting it up for someone else
forWhom.hint: When you set it up for someone else, the wording becomes formal.
forWhom.helperNote: You fill it in together, on their phone or yours. They get the simplest view: large text, one instruction at a time. You see the weekly summary only with their consent.
forWhom.memberHint: Pick a family member, or link up later on the Helper page.

underage.title: This part is for adults.
underage.body: Children appear on the parent's plan as a shared session: "Shared 10 minutes". The parent finds it in their own Move section.

modalities.hint: Pick as many as you like. The picture is enough.
modalities.hint_formal: Pick as many as you like. The picture is enough.
modalities.recommended: Our suggestion to begin with. You can change it any time.
modalities.recommended_formal: Our suggestion to begin with. You can change it any time.
modalities.singleRole: Two short strength sessions a week add a lot to this. Shall I put them in?
modalities.empty: We could not load the activities right now.

schedule.fixedHint: Yoga, swimming, team practice — anything on a set day at a set time. The week is built around them.
schedule.fixedLater: You can add these later in settings.
schedule.fixedLater_formal: You can add these later in settings.

equipment.hint: What you have at home. Weights are asked at the first strength session.

health.intro: Ten short questions. The answers only set the intensity; they never take access away. We store only the resulting setting, not the answers.
health.skipped: Skipped. The week is built cautiously and we will ask again later.
health.skipped_formal: Skipped. The week is built cautiously and we will ask again later.

q.fainting_formal: In the last six months, have you felt faint or fainted?
q.breathlessAtRest: Are you short of breath even at rest?

q.fellOnce_formal: Have you fallen in the last year?
q.fellTwice: Have you fallen twice or more in the last year?
q.fellTwice_formal: Have you fallen twice or more in the last year?

q.doctorSaidSupervised_formal: Has a doctor told you to exercise only under supervision?

result.hrOff: We work without heart-rate targets: breathing and how you feel set the pace.
